notes_for_editor: Only one register record and one undated fan-site photo caption; no build date, current status, staffing or access found. The 1963 map and 1985 repeater proposal are cited as the register reports them; the map itself was not read. The caption's Mattawan Tower may be this tower, but the caption gives no location. The Canada Lookouts Ontario list has a MATTAWAN entry at Tower Lake, Mattawa with no detail; it may be this tower or another, so it is not used. The provincial tower layer (LIO) has a fire-tower point at these coordinates, flagged Unverified, with no height, date or status; the dataset page was not read, so it is not cited. No height_m is set: the 100 ft figure is from 1963 and is not confirmed for today.
